title: PrincipalContext
description: Provider-neutral representation of the authenticated principal (fabric#3, 05 §2 Identity). Identity is adopted (OIDC/OAuth/SCIM), not built: a product resolves 'which principal' from this contract alone and never reaches into an identity server.

principalId.description: Stable subject identifier (the OIDC 'sub'), not an email or a credential.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for audit and UX.

roles.description: Coarse role names held in the current tenant.

claims.description: Optional provider-neutral claims (e.g. selected OIDC claims), string-valued and opaque to the contract. Never a place for secrets or tokens.
